title: A Busy Afternoon at the Chemist

sentences.text_target: Lucas walked quickly to the local chemist shop because his leg hurt after his run.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈluːkəs wɔːkt ˈkwɪkli tuː ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈkɛmɪst ʃɒp bɪˈkɒz hɪz lɛɡ hɜːt ˈɑːftər hɪz rʌn/
sentences.text_native: Lucas a marché rapidement vers la pharmacie de quartier parce que sa jambe le faisait souffrir après sa course.

sentences.text_target: He pushed the heavy glass entrance and noticed several customers standing near the counter.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pʊʃt ðə ˈhɛvi ɡlɑːs ˈɛntrəns ænd ˈnəʊtɪst ˈsɛvrəl ˈkʌstəməz ˈstændɪŋ nɪə ðə ˈkaʊntə/
sentences.text_native: Il a poussé la lourde porte vitrée et a remarqué plusieurs clients debout près du comptoir.

sentences.text_target: A helpful shop assistant looked up from her computer and smiled at him.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈhɛlpfʊl ʃɒp əˈsɪstənt lʊkt ʌp frɒm hɜː kəmˈpjuːtə ænd smaɪld æt hɪm/
sentences.text_native: Une vendeuse serviable a levé les yeux de son ordinateur et lui a souri.

sentences.text_target: Lucas joined the short queue and waited patiently for his turn.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈluːkəs dʒɔɪnd ðə ʃɔːt kjuː ænd ˈweɪtɪd ˈpeɪʃəntli fɔː hɪz tɜːn/
sentences.text_native: Lucas s'est mis dans la courte file d'attente et a attendu patiemment son tour.

sentences.text_target: When the previous customer left, he stepped forward to explain his minor injury.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn ðə ˈpriːvɪəs ˈkʌstəmə lɛft, hiː stɛpt ˈfɔːwəd tuː ɪkˈspleɪn hɪz ˈmaɪnə ˈɪndʒəri/
sentences.text_native: Quand le client précédent est parti, il s'est avancé pour expliquer sa blessure bénigne.

sentences.text_target: He showed the young woman behind the desk a nasty red rash on his lower leg.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ʃəʊd ðə jʌŋ ˈwʊmən bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɛsk ə ˈnɑːsti rɛd ræʃ ɒn hɪz ˈləʊə lɛɡ/
sentences.text_native: Il a montré à la jeune femme derrière le comptoir une vilaine éruption cutanée rouge sur le bas de sa jambe.

sentences.text_target: It looked very itchy, and he needed immediate relief from the constant burning sensation.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt lʊkt ˈvɛri ˈɪtʃi, ænd hiː ˈniːdɪd ɪˈmiːdiət rɪˈliːf frɒm ðə ˈkɒnstənt ˈbɜːnɪŋ sɛnˈseɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Elle avait l'air très irritante, et il avait besoin d'un soulagement immédiat face à cette sensation de brûlure constante.

sentences.text_target: The professional employee asked if he had any known allergies to common medical ingredients.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə prəˈfɛʃənl ɪmˈplɔɪi ɑːskt ɪf hiː hæd ˈɛni nəʊn ˈælədʒiz tuː ˈkɒmən ˈmɛdɪkəl ɪnˈɡriːdiənts/
sentences.text_native: L'employée professionnelle a demandé s'il avait des allergies connues à des principes actifs courants.

sentences.text_target: Lucas shook his head and confirmed that his general health was usually quite robust.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈluːkəs ʃʊk hɪz hɛd ænd kənˈfɜːmd ðæt hɪz ˈʤɛnərəl hɛlt wɒz ˈjuːʒʊəli kwaɪt rəʊˈbʌst/
sentences.text_native: Lucas a fait non de la tête et a confirmé que sa santé générale était habituellement plutôt robuste.

sentences.text_target: She checked her computer system to verify available treatments on the electronic database.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː tʧɛkt hɜː kəmˈpjuːtə ˈsɪstəm tuː ˈvɛrɪfaɪ əˈveɪləbl ˈtriːtmənts ɒn ði ɪlɛkˈtrɒnɪk ˈdeɪtəbeɪs/
sentences.text_native: Elle a consulté son ordinateur pour vérifier les traitements disponibles sur la base de données informatique.

sentences.text_target: Then she walked quickly towards a tall metal shelf to fetch a special soothing ointment.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃiː wɔːkt ˈkwɪkli təˈwɔːdz ə tɔːl ˈmɛtl ʃɛlf tuː fɛʧ ə ˈspɛʃəl ˈsuːðɪŋ ˈɔɪntmənt/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, elle a marché rapidement vers une grande étagère métallique pour aller chercher une pommade apaisante spécifique.

sentences.text_target: She placed a small white tube of soothing cream directly onto the shiny glass surface.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː pleɪst ə smɔːl waɪt tjuːb ɒv ˈsuːðɪŋ kriːm daɪˈrɛktli ˈɒntuː ðə ˈʃaɪni ɡlɑːs ˈsɜːfɪs/
sentences.text_native: Elle a posé un petit tube blanc de crème apaisante directement sur la surface en verre brillant.

sentences.text_target: Along with the cream, she picked up a supportive elastic bandage for a potential joint sprain.
sentences.phonetic: /əˈlɒŋ wɪð ðə kriːm, ʃiː pɪkt ʌp ə səˈpɔːtɪv ɪˈlæstɪk ˈbændɪdʒ fɔːr ə pəˈtɛnʃəl dʒɔɪnt spreɪn/
sentences.text_native: En plus de la crème, elle a pris une bande élastique de maintien pour une éventuelle entorse articulaire.

sentences.text_target: Lucas listened very carefully while she explained the specific usage instructions.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈluːkəs ˈlɪsnd ˈvɛri ˈkɛəfʊli waɪl ʃiː ɪkˈspleɪnd ðə spɪˈsɪfɪk ˈjuːsɪdʒ ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz/
sentences.text_native: Lucas a écouté très attentivement pendant qu'elle lui expliquait les instructions d'utilisation.

sentences.text_target: She advised him to read the paper leaflet inside the cardboard box before the first application.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ədˈvaɪzd hɪm tuː riːd ðə ˈpeɪpə ˈliːflɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈkɑːdbɔːd bɒks bɪˈfɔː ðə fɜːst ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Elle lui a conseillé de lire la notice en papier à l'intérieur de la boîte en carton avant la première application.

sentences.text_target: She mentioned that the correct dosage and frequency were clearly printed on the back panel.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈmɛnʃʊnd ðæt ðə kəˈrɛkt ˈdəʊsɪdʒ ænd ˈfriːkwənsi wɜː ˈklɪəli ˈprɪntɪd ɒn ðə bæk ˈpænl/
sentences.text_native: Elle a précisé que la posologie et la fréquence exactes étaient clairement indiquées au dos.

sentences.text_target: The expert staff member also warned him about potential mild side effects like feeling slightly sleepy.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈɛkspɜːt stɑːf ˈmɛmbə ˈɔːlsəʊ wɔːnd hɪm əˈbaʊt pəˈtɛnʃəl maɪld saɪd ɪˈfɛkts laɪk ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈslaɪtli ˈsliːpi/
sentences.text_native: La pharmacienne l'a également mis en garde contre d'éventuels effets secondaires bénins, comme une légère somnolence.

sentences.text_target: Lucas nodded because he understood the medical advice completely.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈluːkəs ˈnɒdɪd bɪˈkɒz hiː ˌʌndəˈstʊd ðə ˈmɛdɪkəl ədˈvaɪs kəmˈpliːtli/
sentences.text_native: Lucas a hoché la tête parce qu'il avait parfaitement compris ses conseils médicaux.

sentences.text_target: Then she typed the final total amount into the modern electronic cash register.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃiː taɪpt ðə ˈfaɪnl ˈtəʊtəl əˈmaʊnt ˈɪntuː ðə ˈmɒdən ɪlɛkˈtrɒnɪk kæʃ ˈrɛdʒɪstə/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, elle a tapé le montant total à la caisse enregistreuse électronique.

sentences.text_target: The total price for both items came to exactly twenty-four euros.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈtəʊtəl praɪs fɔː bəʊθ ˈaɪtəmz keɪm tuː ɪɡˈzækli ˈtwɛnti-fɔː ˈjʊərəʊz/
sentences.text_native: Le prix total pour les deux articles s'élevait exactement à vingt-quatre euros.

sentences.text_target: Lucas took his wallet from his pocket to pay for the medical products.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈluːkəs tʊk hɪz ˈwɒlɪt frɒm hɪz ˈpɒkɪt tuː peɪ fɔː ðə ˈmɛdɪkəl ˈprɒdʌkts/
sentences.text_native: Lucas a sorti son portefeuille de sa poche pour payer les produits de santé.

sentences.text_target: He decided to use his insurance card for possible reimbursement later.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː juːz hɪz ɪnˈʃʊərəns kɑːd fɔː ˈpɒsəbl ˌriːɪmˈbɜːsmənt ˈleɪtə/
sentences.text_native: Il a décidé d'utiliser sa carte de mutuelle en vue d'un éventuel remboursement ultérieur.

sentences.text_target: He tapped his plastic card against the small wireless payment terminal.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː tæpt hɪz ˈplæstɪk kɑːd əˈgɛnst ðə smɔːl ˈwaɪəlɪs ˈpeɪmənt ˈtɜːmɪnl/
sentences.text_native: Il a posé sa carte bancaire sur le petit terminal de paiement sans contact.

sentences.text_target: The machine beeped twice to show that the financial transaction was successful.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃiːn biːpt twaɪs tuː ʃəʊ ðæt ðə fɪˈnænʃəl trænˈzækʃən wɒz səkˈsɛsfʊl/
sentences.text_native: La machine a bipé deux fois pour indiquer que la transaction avait réussi.

sentences.text_target: The friendly assistant printed a detailed paper receipt and handed it to him.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfrɛndli əˈsɪstənt ˈprɪntɪd ə ˈdiːteɪld ˈpeɪpə rɪˈsiːt ænd ˈhændɪd ɪt tuː hɪm/
sentences.text_native: L'employée aimable a imprimé un ticket de caisse détaillé et le lui a remis.

sentences.text_target: Lucas put the small receipt safely inside his coat pocket.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈluːkəs pʊt ðə smɔːl rɪˈsiːt ˈseɪfli ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz kəʊt ˈpɒkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Lucas a soigneusement rangé le ticket dans la poche de son manteau.

sentences.text_target: She carefully placed the tube and the bandage inside a clean paper bag.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈkɛəfʊli pleɪst ðə tjuːb ænd ðə ˈbændɪdʒ ɪnˈsaɪd ə kliːn ˈpeɪpə bæɡ/
sentences.text_native: Elle a délicatement glissé le tube et la bande dans un sachet en papier propre.

sentences.text_target: Lucas thanked the staff member warmly for her excellent customer service.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈluːkəs θæŋkt ðə stɑːf ˈmɛmbə ˈwɔːmli fɔː hɜːr ˈɛksələnt ˈkʌstəmə ˈsɜːvɪs/
sentences.text_native: Lucas a chaleureusement remercié la pharmacienne pour son excellent service client.

sentences.text_target: He wished her a good afternoon and walked out of the pharmacy.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɪʃt hɜːr ə ɡʊd ˈɑːftənuːn ænd wɔːkt aʊt ɒv ðə ˈfɑːməsi/
sentences.text_native: Il lui a souhaité un bon après-midi et est sorti de la pharmacie.

sentences.text_target: He hoped his leg would feel much better soon so he could run again.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː həʊpt hɪz lɛɡ wʊd fiːl mʌʧ ˈbɛtə suːn səʊ hiː kʊd rʌn əˈɡɛn/
sentences.text_native: Il espérait que sa jambe irait beaucoup mieux bientôt pour pouvoir refaire de la course à pied.
